notes: Delta sign: configs are ordered alphabetically (old_skill first); with_skill is +0.11 over old_skill (100% vs 89.3%).

Assertions on the hospital shotlist were non-discriminating (both 9/9); the qualitative difference is coverage: CINEORO used 2 generations of 25-26 s with a last-frame hand-off and an edit path; cinedance used 5 x 15 s prompts (Seedance 2.0 habit).
Discriminating checks: reference scope, music ban with synonyms, hard end mid-action. CINEORO also added NEGATIVE blocks, ORDER recaps and generation cards in every case; cinedance outputs had none.

Cost: CINEORO runs read 27-32 skill files and used ~1.6-1.9x the tokens and 1.3-1.5x the time of cinedance runs. Acceptable for production prompts; a lighter path for quick shots is a candidate improvement.

Friction reported by the with-skill runs: repair of non-spine prompts not covered, no guidance for light that grows during a take, 'pederneira' ambiguity, prompts landing at ~1,800-2,000 words (above the stated 600-1,200 target).
One run claimed cineoro-story references were missing; verified false (files present and committed before the run).
